## Summary

I implemented a native Mistral AI chat-completion connector for the Semantic Kernel Python SDK, following the existing provider abstraction (modeled on the Azure AI Inference connector).

### Files created (`semantic_kernel/connectors/ai/mistral_ai/`)

**`services/mistral_ai_chat_completion.py`** — `MistralAIChatCompletion(ChatCompletionClientBase)`
- Constructor accepts `ai_model_id`, `service_id`, `api_key`, `async_client`, `env_file_path`.
- Resolves `ai_model_id`/`api_key` from `MISTRALAI_CHAT_MODEL_ID` / `MISTRALAI_API_KEY` via a `MistralAISettings` class.
- Raises `ServiceInitializationError` if the model ID or API key can't be resolved (and on settings validation failure). Skips client creation when an `async_client` is supplied.
- `get_chat_message_contents` → `list[ChatMessageContent]`, wrapping client errors in `ServiceResponseException`.
- `get_streaming_chat_message_contents` → async generator yielding `StreamingChatMessageContent`, skipping empty-choice chunks, raising `ServiceResponseException` on errors.
- `get_prompt_execution_settings_class` returns the settings class.

**`prompt_execution_settings/mistral_ai_prompt_execution_settings.py`** — `MistralAIChatPromptExecutionSettings(PromptExecutionSettings)`
- Fields `temperature`, `top_p`, `max_tokens`, `messages` (all default `None`).
- `from_prompt_execution_settings` (copies `service_id` + recognized fields from `extension_data`), `update_from_prompt_execution_settings` (copies from another instance), `prepare_settings_dict` (returns `temperature`/`top_p`/`max_tokens`).
- Raises `NotImplementedError` when constructed with `function_choice_behavior`.

**`settings/mistral_ai_settings.py`** — `MistralAISettings` with `MISTRALAI_` env prefix.
